_doc: Relational memory phrase lists, owned by the memory module (extraction) and read as-is by the voice runtime (vpvoice/memory_use.py). Lowercase substrings, Latin and Devanagari. forget: this call must not be remembered; forgetAll: nothing about the person (also files a forget request); keepAsk/keepAffirm: her ask to keep a detail and the caller's yes (memory's extraction checks the pair); personalCues: a volunteered personal, non-sensitive detail; sensitiveCues: never asked to keep. STUB from the voice builder 2026-10-24 with memory's examples; memory overwrites.
